map.肝性脑病 West Haven 分级 使用指南: Hepatic Encephalopathy West Haven Grading User Guide
map.算法：意识状态、行为变化、认知/智力、扑翼样震颤各取 0~IV 级（0 正常、I: Algorithm: consciousness, behaviour change, cognition/intellect and asterixis are each graded 0 to IV (0 normal, I mild, II drowsy/abnormal behaviour, III stupor, IV coma); the highest of the four is taken as the HE grade. Grade 0 is mild...
map.分级评估：由意识、行为、认知、扑翼样震颤取最高级定 HE 分级: Grading assessment: take the highest grade among consciousness, behaviour, cognition and asterixis to set the HE grade
map.治疗分层：I-II 级门诊/日间，III-IV 级住院 ICU: Treatment stratification: grades I-II outpatient/day care, grades III-IV inpatient ICU
map.诱因管理：识别并去除感染、出血、便秘、低钾等诱因: Trigger management: identify and remove triggers such as infection, bleeding, constipation and hypokalemia
map.建议乳果糖口服（目标 2~3 次软便/日）并定期评估，多数可门诊管理: Oral lactulose is recommended (target 2-3 soft stools per day) with regular review; most patients can be managed as outpatients
map.轻微型肝性脑病实验室/影像正常，但心理与神经生理测试异常，影响生活质量与驾驶安全: Minimal hepatic encephalopathy shows normal laboratory and imaging results but abnormal psychological and neurophysiological tests, affecting quality of life and driving safety. Oral lactulose is recommended (target 2-3 soft stools per day) with regular review; most patients can be managed as outpatients.
map.乳果糖在结肠被细菌酵解产酸，使肠腔 pH 下降、氨以 NH₄⁺ 形式被截留并随粪: Lactulose is fermented by colonic bacteria into acid, lowering luminal pH so ammonia is trapped as NH4+ and excreted with the stool; it also promotes bowel movements and reduces ammonia absorption. It is a basic drug for HE at all stages.
